name: Złodziej Życzeń
source:
A unique fairy tale for the youngest readers!
---
'The Thief of Wishes' is an interactive book for kids which will take you again into a fairy tale world - where "…and they lived happily ever after" is only one of many possible endings and nothing is as simple as it looks.

The gameplay is focused on traveling between two different worlds (a lovely old town and it's nightmare version) and choosing one of the available actions/questions to make the story progress - which allows children to take control of the direction of the narrative.

The main protagonist of the app is a brave and book-loving girl - Catharine. Her goal is to defend the dream distorted by a mysterious monster, save the villagers, and reveal the secret of the Magic Fountain.
translation:
适合小读者的独特童话！
---
《愿望小偷》是一本儿童互动读物，它将带你再次进入童话世界——“……他们从此幸福地生活在一起”只是众多可能结局中的一个，一切都不像看起来那么简单。

游戏玩法的重点是在两个不同的世界（一个可爱的老城区和一个噩梦版本）之间旅行，并选择一个可用的动作/问题来推动故事的进展——这让孩子们能够控制叙事的方向。

该应用程序的主角是一个勇敢且热爱读书的女孩——凯瑟琳。她的目标是捍卫被神秘怪物扭曲的梦想，拯救村民，并揭开魔法喷泉的秘密。
